apparatus.note: The original print has a marginal alternative “Or, God and the Father” concerning the opening address. The main text is unchanged.
The original printed margin provides the alternatives “Or, inquiry” and “Or, appeal” for the wording about a good conscience. The main verse is retained.
The original 1901 printed margin notes that some ancient authorities read “unto sins.” This is preserved as manuscript apparatus, not the running verse.
The 1901 margin explains “she” with “That is, The church, or, The sister.” Preserve the ambiguity and distinguish the original note from the main text.
